 30 Oct, 2026 
 State-Level ‘PM-KISAN Utsav’ Held in Bhubaneswar; 24th Instalment Released to Over 3.5 Million Farmer Families in Odisha. 
 Chief Minister Shri Mohan Charan Majhi attended and addressed the state-level ‘PM-KISAN Utsav’ held in Bhubaneswar today.
 On this occasion, the Hon’ble Prime Minister of India, Shri Narendra Modi, virtually launched the disbursement of the 24th instalment under the nationwide ‘PM-KISAN’ scheme from Banaskantha, Gujarat. As part of this initiative, financial assistance was directly transferred through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the bank accounts of more than 35 lakh eligible farmer families in Odisha.
